bible.summary: Grocery shop: striped awning and tube lights, shelves with goods and price tags along the back wall with a red 'sale' star, bread and hanging sausages on the lower shelf, crates of apples and oranges on the left, counter on the right with a cash register, dial scales and an abacus: customer and seller.

variants.change: Pharmacy: green cross glowing on the back wall between white medicine shelves, 'wash your hands' poster, drawer cabinets, a long white counter with a glass partition, cash register, mortar and pestle, pill boxes and a small plant

Barbershop: striped barber pole, haircut posters and a wall clock, towels on a rail, big arched mirror over a shelf with tonics, a jar of combs and clippers, red barber chair with hair clippings around it, chequered wall tiles and floor, a lamp and a potted plant

bible.prompt: small shop interior, counter with cash register, shelves with goods, price tags
